title: Money: Naira and Kobo, Profit and Loss
seo_title: Money – Primary 4 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Convert naira to kobo and kobo to naira; add, subtract, multiply and divide money; solve problems on profit and loss and shopping, including online shopping. (summary of the NERDC Primary 4 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free Primary 4 maths worksheets on money in naira and kobo: converting, adding and subtracting money, change, profit and loss, multiplying and dividing money and online shopping. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • ₦1 = 100 kobo. ₦3.50 means 3 naira and 50 kobo = 350 kobo.
  • Add and subtract money like decimals: line up the points.
  • If the selling price is more than the cost price, there is a profit. If it is less, there is a loss.

Examples

Example

Change ₦4.25 to kobo

4 × 100 + 25

Answer: 425 kobo

Example

Bought for ₦6,000, sold for ₦7,500

7,500 − 6,000

Answer: profit of ₦1,500

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
₦1 = 10 kobo₦1 = 100 kobo.
Mixing up profit and lossCompare the selling price with the cost price.
Forgetting delivery or other costsAdd every cost before finding the total.
